questions.question: What does chapter 34 define?
options: The borders of the promised land
The plans for the war against Canaan
The rules for making and keeping vows
The offerings for the yearly feasts
questions.answer: The borders of the promised land

questions.question: Who were appointed to help divide the land?
options: Moses and Aaron the high priest
The heads of the twelve tribes

questions.question: A leader from each tribe was chosen to help distribute the land.
The land of Canaan was to be divided among the tribes as an _____.
_____ the priest and Joshua were to oversee dividing the land.
